page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Printed lines run from the top to the foot, centred. No margins hold text. The page is heavily faded and shows mirrored show-through from the reverse side.
page.notes: The title page is very faded and partly illegible; the mirrored show-through from the other side makes most lines unreadable. The large word at the top reads as "STVPENDA" with [?] uncertainty, and the first line may read "INSTITVTIO". Lines marked illegible could not be read letter by letter. No engraving, stamp or running head is visible.
